name: amaltash-calculators
description: Compound interest, investment, retirement, CD, S&P 500 and DCA calculators with charts.

interface.longDescription:
Amaltash investment and retirement calculators inside ChatGPT. Ask a money question in plain words. Get the math and a chart you can change. No account needed.

Compound interest calculator.
- What does $10,000 grow to at 5% in 10 years?
- Compound interest with monthly contributions: $10,000 plus $200 a month at 5%.
- Compare daily, monthly and yearly compounding.
- Future value calculator: what is $10,000 worth at 6% in 20 years?

Investment calculator.
- What could $500 a month grow to in 30 years?
- Investment growth: what is $10 a day worth after 20 years?
- What could $1,000 a month in an index fund grow to by age 65?

Retirement calculator.
- How much do I need to retire? Can I retire at 60 with $800,000?
- How long will my savings last if I spend $4,000 a month?
- How long will $1 million last in retirement?
- Retirement withdrawal calculator: how much can I take out each month for 30 years?
- Test the 4% rule on my retirement savings.
- Sequence of returns: what if the market falls in my first year of retirement?

CD calculator and high-yield savings calculator.
- What will $5,000 earn in a 1-year CD at 4%?
- CD interest calculator: 6-month CD vs 12-month CD.
- APY calculator: what does $20,000 earn in a high-yield savings account at 4%?
- Savings interest calculator: how much interest on $50,000 in a year?

Net worth calculator.
- What is my net worth? How does it compare to average net worth by age?
- I'm 35 with $120,000 in assets and $40,000 in debt. Where do I stand?

S&P 500 calculator.
- What would $1,000 in the S&P 500 have become from 2000 to 2025?
- S&P 500 average return over the last 30 years.

Stock return calculator.
- What would $1,000 in Apple have become over 5 years?
- If I had invested in Costco, what would I have?
- What if I had bought Nvidia 10 years ago?

DCA calculator.
- Dollar-cost averaging: $200 a month into VOO, with a chart.
- Lump sum or dollar-cost averaging: which did better for QQQ?

Stock questions work for more than 12,000 US stocks and ETFs, updated each night. Search by company name or ticker, like Alphabet or GOOGL.

Risk calculators.
- Loss recovery: if I lose 30%, what gain gets me back to even?
- Stock market crash calculator: what would a 40% drop do to my portfolio?
- Position size calculator: how big is one position if I risk 1%?
- T-bill ladder calculator: plan a Treasury bill ladder for $20,000.

How it works.
Each answer shows an interactive card. Move a slider or tap a button to change the years, the amount, the rate or the stock, and the chart redraws. Every result says how it was worked out and what it assumes.

Where the numbers come from.
US stock and ETF prices, updated nightly. US market returns since 1928 from NYU Stern. Net worth by age from a 2022 Federal Reserve survey.

Also from Amaltash.
Investment, CD and high-yield savings calculators are also on amaltash.com. Made by Amaltash Advisors LLC.

You don't need to sign in. It doesn't ask for personal data. It can't trade or move money.

Results are for education only. They are not investment advice or a promise of future results. Projections are hypothetical. Past results don't predict future ones. You can lose money.
defaultPrompt: What does $10,000 grow to at 5% compounded monthly over 10 years if I add $200 a month? Show a chart.
I'm 60, retiring now with $800,000, 60% in stocks, no other income, spending $4,000 a month. Will my money last to age 90?
What would $200 a month in VOO have become over the last 5 years? Show a chart.

positive.description: Compound interest with monthly deposits and a chart.
positive.prompt: What does $10,000 grow to at 5% compounded monthly over 10 years if I add $200 a month? Show a chart.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls compound_interest once. Replies with the ending balance, total deposits and interest earned, and shows an interactive growth chart. States its assumptions and that results are for education only.

positive.description: Retirement check: will savings last to a target age.
positive.prompt: I'm 60, retiring now with $800,000, 60% in stocks, no other income, spending $4,000 a month. Will my money last to age 90?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls retirement_plan once. Says whether the savings last to age 90 in its scenarios and shows the balance over time as a chart. States that projections are hypothetical and not advice.

positive.description: Past dollar-cost averaging into a fund, with a chart.
positive.prompt: What would $200 a month in VOO have become over the last 5 years? Show a chart.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls replay_past_investing once for VOO. Replies with the total invested and the ending value from historical prices, and shows a chart. Notes that past results do not predict future ones.

positive.description: Gain needed to recover from a loss.
positive.prompt: If I lose 30%, what gain gets me back to even?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls drawdown_recovery once. Replies that about a 42.9% gain is needed to get back to even.

positive.description: Interest earned on a certificate of deposit.
positive.prompt: What will $5,000 earn in a 1-year CD at 4%?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls compound_interest once with a 1-year term at 4%. Replies with the interest earned (about $200, depending on compounding) and the ending balance.

negative.description: Trade request. Expected: no Amaltash tool is called. The connector is read-only and cannot place trades or move money, so ChatGPT should say it cannot do this.
negative.prompt: Buy 10 shares of Apple for me

negative.description: Personal investment advice. Expected: no Amaltash tool is called. The calculators do math only and do not recommend buying or selling a security.
negative.prompt: Should I sell my Tesla stock?

negative.description: Unrelated request. Expected: no Amaltash tool is called; ChatGPT answers on its own.
